finding.finding: The supplied authoritative snapshots establish power loss at Beruwala and Padukka, and a down transmission link from Homagama to Padukka. No equipment-state claim is made.

Resolved faults are S01 grid power, S09 grid power, and L09 backhaul. Equipment is confirmed OK at S01 and S09. Available crews have equipment and generator skills, but no backhaul skill is listed. No road closures or hazards are reported. G1 is available at DEPOT with 120 minutes of fuel; generator deployment actions take 10 minutes. The catalogue contains applicable generator actions for S01 and S09 and a repair action for L09, but no crew is documented with the required backhaul skill. No evidence-supported safety or impossibility reason permits deferring an action.

questions.question: Can you confirm whether a backhaul-skilled crew is available to repair link L09? The listed crews have equipment and generator skills, but no backhaul skill is shown.

findings: Extracted facts match the cited authoritative snapshots and the site directory: S01 is Beruwala (BER87) with grid power unavailable; S09 is Padukka (PAD85) with grid power unavailable; L09 is the HOM12-to-PAD85 link with backhaul down.
The sole action targets S01. Its route begins at DEPOT and reaches S01; the 5-minute travel precedes work_start_min 5. The 10-minute work duration gives work_end_min 15, matching the recorded value.

The Veyangoda complaint, planned Gampaha interruption, and unconfirmed Padukka rumour do not establish current asset-state facts. The plan appropriately leaves the related needs unmet rather than treating those reports as verified claims.
